articles.summary: SALT LAKE CITY — September 17, 2026 — ReposiTrak, Inc. (NYSE: TRAK), the leader in retail supply chain, merchandising, compliance and traceability solutions, today announced that implementation of Touchless Retail™ is underway with a paper products supplier at a large East Coast retailer. Touchless Retail combines ReposiTrak’s best-in-class DSD technology, including perpetual inventory, demand-driven ordering
